# Relocated notices: files deliberately deleted from this repository because they now live
# somewhere else, together with their copyright, licence and credit notices.
# Format, one entry per line:   <glob pattern>  ->  <where the files and notices live now>
#
# Read by the Attribution guard and the License Guard. A file matching an entry may be
# DELETED without being reported as a violation. Nothing else changes: editing or removing
# a notice in a file that still exists here is still a violation.
# The guards read this list from the base branch (pull requests) or from the commit before
# a push, so a change can't relocate its own deletions. Add the entry first, then delete.

# the copyright footers are kept in that repo: LICENSE.md, de/LICENSE.md, README.md,
# de/index.md and .vitepress/config.mts.
